To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have designed SPLACID, a language for the specification of TMs based on ACTA, that promotes the reuse and the composition of TM features.

we have designed and developed a SPL-oriented, ACTA-based language, called SPLA CID, for specifying TMs in terms the selection and speciali zation of TM features, which are expressed in terms of ACTA.

(i) SPLACID, as a language, can be used to describe TMs, in terms of the features they share, and the features they do not, and (ii) SPLACID is a language that can be used to specify TMs, in a precise, rigorous and structured way.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a SPL-oriented language, SPLACID, that is based on ACTA and that is dedicated to the specification of TMs.
the definition and the application of a language for the formal specification of a set of TMs in a software product line (SPL) perspective.

a) identifying and specifying the set of TM standard and non-standard features; b) identifying and specifying reusable and composable TM commonalities and variability; c) providing a formal language to specify TM standard and nonstandard features and to support the identification, the specification and the reuse of TM commonalities, variabilities and relaxations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
SPLACID is a language for reusing (varying) ACID properties.
SPLACID is the first language that provides a rigorous and precise way for describing TMs and their relaxed ACID properties.
SPLACID represents a relevant and promising tool to face the challenge of the specification and reuse of TMs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
SPLACID is a language that allows to specify TMs as a set of reusable features, which can be composed to build new TMs.
, by using SPLACID, we can: (i) specify TMs by selecting and specializing a set of standard TM features; (ii) specify TMs as software products; and (iii) reuse and compose standard TM features.
we contribute in easing the specification and the reuse of relaxed ACID properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that
SPLACID can support software product line engineers in specifying and reusing TM properties.
SPLACID is a promising tool that can support the development of SPL-oriented TMS.
, by using SPLACID, it is possible to specify and reuse (varying) TM standard features, thus easing the identification and the specification of TM commonalities and variability.
